reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of all 40 original B1/B2 verb questions: full German sentences, separable verbs, tense and case, every offered distractor, accepted answer, bilingual feedback, contextual variation and provenance. Corrected vague or misleading inherited senses for messen, mitbestimmen, mitreden, montieren and nachgehen. Existing GM2 draft/production objectives checked; no same assessable objective identified. Independent human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approval remain pending.
